fields.summary: QA- End to End Validation for TypeScript tool "CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN"
fields.description:
## Summary

Perform end-to-end validation of the **CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN** tool on a **TypeScript** repository using the Testable QA environment. Verify successful execution, metric/report accuracy, and correct platform ingestion.

### Objective

Validate that **CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN** integrates correctly with the Testable White Box analysis pipeline and produces the expected outputs mapped in **Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2** (White Box sheet).

TypeScript primary SCA/SBOM tool on dependency graph rows; validate CycloneDX/cdxgen SBOM output for TypeScript projects.

### Strategy Mapping Reference

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source file | Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2 (White Box sheet) |
| Tool | CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN |
| Metrics covered by this tool | **2** |
| Language focus | TypeScript |

### Metrics Covered (from Strategy v0.2)

| L3 Technique | L4 Classification | L5 Metric | TS Primary | TS Secondary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dependency Risk (SCA) | Transitive Dependency Analysis | Hidden Relationship Mapping | npm ls | — |
| Dependency Risk (SCA) | License Compliance Testing | Legal Risk Validation | N/A | — |

### Validation Scope

* Verify the tool executes successfully on a representative TypeScript repository.
* Confirm raw tool output is generated without errors.
* Validate mapped metrics above are present directly or via documented derivation.
* Compare platform-ingested values with local tool execution.
* Ensure reports are stored/displayed correctly in Testable.

### Expected Result

* **CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN** completes execution successfully.
* All **2** mapped metrics are supported or correctly derived.
* Results display correctly in Testable without tool failure messages.

### Deliverables

* End-to-end validation results
* Execution logs
* Generated CYCLONEDX/CDXGEN report/output
* Screenshots of successful execution (if applicable)
